details: Spire construction. Keep the full silhouette of the supplied exploratory concept: tall slim upright plum thorax topped by a narrow raised cockpit, small amber sight glass, bone ceramic central chest, one high slab intercooler behind the shoulders, and long plum forward-jointed legs with paired bone toe caps. Own-left hangs low with one dominant squared particle accelerator in a long underslung cradle with a recessed pale-violet ceramic lens. Own-right is a compact unarmed closed maintenance claw. Show the whole vertical machine, both hands, the asymmetry of the long main arm and separate feet. Clean continuous surfaces and broad paint planes.
